name: Railway

free_tier.notes: One-time grant at signup; expires after 30 days or when spent, then account reverts to the Free plan. Trial limited to 1 GB RAM, shared vCPU, 5 services/project.
Perpetual Free plan after trial ends; unused credit does not roll over.
Ephemeral storage 1 GB; image size limit 4 GB; 1 replica per service.

notes: Railway's model is a one-time $5/30-day trial (no credit card required per official pricing page) that then reverts to a perpetual Free plan with a $1/month non-rolling credit — very small, effectively only for tiny always-on or intermittent workloads. Stateful volumes created during the trial are deleted 30 days after trial expiration unless you upgrade. Paid plans: Hobby $5/mo (includes $5 usage), Pro $20/seat/mo; usage billed per-second beyond included credit. This replaces the older setup where Railway had removed its free tier entirely (2023) — the $1/mo Free plan is a newer reintroduction.
